name: The Scrivener
source:
I hired many copyists in my life, yet none so strange as Bartleby. He works and refuses, eats and abstains, speaks only of his preferring – and drives me to the brink. 

Step into a world of silence, obsession, and moral reckoning, where every choice has a cost.

[From [url=https://winglesswurm.itch.io/the-scrivener]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我一生中雇佣过很多抄写员，但没有一个像巴特比那样奇怪。他工作又拒绝，吃饭又节制，只谈论他的喜好——这把我逼到了崩溃的边缘。

走进一个沉默、痴迷和道德清算的世界，每一个选择都有代价。

[来自[url=https://winglesswurm.itch.io/the-scrivener]Itch.io[/url]]
